poppler-26.07.0.role: primary page-aware text and visual conversion

poppler_plus_markitdown_union.role: diagnostic union only; not emitted to avoid duplication

decision: Use Poppler as the primary converter. Keep MarkItDown as an optional comparator because wholesale merging adds substantial duplicate/noisy text for only 0.06-1.28 percentage points of token recall. Use PDFium for independent visual acceptance and escalate complex/scanned pages to MinerU in Linux/WSL only when thresholds fail.
